newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plastic Lumber names new CEO.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plastic Lumber names new CEO.

text.p: U.S. Plastic Lumber Corp said Tuesday it appointed Mark Alsentzer president and chief executive officer.
The company's directors issued a statement citing Alsentzer's experience in growing developmental-stage companies into large, profitable multi-service organizations.
The company's previous president, David Farrow, assumes the post of vice chairman and chief operating officer, the company said.
Harold Gebert will remain as chairman, the company said.
Alsentzer's experience includes four years as vice president of Republic Environmental Systems Inc, a subsidiary of Republic Waste Industries.
